_note: Episode 46 (S5E5), story version 2, Kabanata 46: the arks in Manila Bay (the third week of the flood), Tala and Albo on the roof of Kapitan Totoy's ark, Sinag's temptation (golden, beautiful, never a monster), Usman's growl, Albo's choice, Tubal in a flooded warehouse (no blow struck; the record read aloud), Tubal's men welcomed into the arks, M gives the umbrella handle and the Trinity is made whole. Indio is in his forties (grey strands). No weapons used against anyone; scripture is shown only as painting-like scenes, never with text. Prompts setting first; the free endpoint refuses brick, violet, museum, mud, scroll and fighting words. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k101 are montage extras. Season 5 Indio string (conductor): "a Filipino man in his forties with a black topknot with a few grey strands, a long dark grey coat, a red handkerchief on his wrist".
